Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on earlier commitments: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, is task 15 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, which is still blocked? Please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Noted, Daniel: you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being blocked until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Noted, Daniel.

Task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, is bug 12 done from pairing on staging access, and is story 5 done from chasing the PCI scan exceptions, and what did you finish, what’s next, and are you blocked?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 where the sandbox gateway keeps timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment to pair with Daniel on staging access today.
Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted a blocker and your commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.
Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done? Please share what you finished, what’s next, and anything blocking you.
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the sandbox being down and the retry load test slipping, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment to sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page is on track and will resume after idempotency keys are in, Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs staging access, PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox was down, with Maya able to help. A side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration was parked for offline follow-up. Nobody was absent and nobody in the meeting failed to respond. Task 19 was not covered, and its owners will get a follow-up about it, with all follow-ups coming in Teams; thanks everyone.
